default.reason: project management is high-volume, low-stakes coordination work (issue triage, next-up ranking, milestone scoring, status rollups, backlog dedup) so fable is the default tier; only genuinely-hard planning judgment or an irreversible close escalates to opus-4.8. A wrong triage costs a re-run, not a bad production write.

plan.reason: an irreversible coordination action (close or cancel an issue, milestone, or plan) is low-stakes-but-irreversible: the strong model verifies the close so a dormant-but-real item is not swept, and this floor never drops to the cheap tier however routine the close looks. Placed first so a contraction escalates even when it is also flagged high-complexity.

hard planning judgment (decomposing an oversized epic into a coherent sub-issue tree, a cross-cutting replan, or a milestone re-scope) is genuine reasoning work: escalate to opus-4.8 when the scout flags high complexity, placed before the routine rule so a hard-flagged aspect escalates even under the project_management label.

the steady-state project-management pass (triage, next-up ranking, milestone scoring, status rollups, label proposals, backlog dedup) is high-volume, low-stakes coordination: fable is fast and adequate, and a wrong call costs a re-run, not a bad production write.
